task.title: Implement runtime scheduler foundation
task.summary: Add runtime scheduler primitives for Brain leases, daemon job/run states, durable worker questions, block/unblock, retry, stale heartbeat handling, and model policy metadata.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki runtime can coordinate safe scheduler state without full autonomous parallel worker spawning.
acceptance: Runtime state records one active Brain lease with session/ref, heartbeat, active work refs, expiry, and takeover semantics.
Daemon job/run records support question, blocked, unblock/requeue, retry, stale heartbeat, and terminal states with source refs and exact block reasons.
Job records can carry worker profile/model policy metadata including desired model, fallback, budget/risk, and approval refs.
Dispatcher tick remains bounded and does not close roadmap tasks, bypass gates, or spawn unsupported workers silently.
Tests cover lease claim/heartbeat/takeover, block/question/unblock, stale/retry behavior, and bounded dispatch invariants.
non_goals: Do not implement unrestricted parallel worker spawning.
Do not let runtime mutate roadmap truth directly or bypass validation gateways.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

closure_brief.user_intent: Prioritize backend worker daemon scheduling and implement TASK-070 runtime scheduler foundation before UX board work or full parallel worker spawning.
implemented_changes: Added durable Brain lease schema and pure claim/heartbeat/release helpers.
Added worker question records plus ask/answer/unblock helpers that block/requeue daemon jobs with exact reasons.
Added worker profile and model policy metadata on daemon jobs/runs, including dispatcher propagation.
Expanded block kinds for planning/decision/validation/artifact escalation.
Added tests covering Brain lease takeover, worker question block/unblock, model policy propagation, and existing bounded dispatcher retry/stale behavior.
non_goals_preserved: No runtime roadmap truth mutation or validation bypass.
remaining_risks: Fresh implementation validation still required before task closure.
